Open the metawoRld app

Source: R/app.R
launch.Rd

A Shiny app for running a review without writing R:

Usage

launch(
  path = NULL,
  person = getOption("metawoRld.person"),
  launch.browser = TRUE
)

launch_app(path = NULL, person = getOption("metawoRld.person"))

Arguments

path

A project to open. Defaults to none (the Start screen).

person

Your id in the project's people.yml. Defaults to the metawoRld.person option.

launch.browser

Passed to shiny::runApp().

Value

launch() runs the app; launch_app() returns the app object.

Details

  • Start: create a review with a short wizard, open an existing project, or explore the worked example.

  • Overview: progress and what to do next.

  • Inbox: submissions waiting to be accepted; compare two extractions of the same study and pick the right values (reconcile).

  • Review: verify values against the papers (the review_values() app).

  • Setup: people, variables, group categories, planned analyses, criteria and the form.

  • Check: check_project() in plain language.

  • Publish: build and open the living meta-analysis website.

  • Sync: share work with the team through Git (sync_project()); new submissions from others then appear in the Inbox.

Everything the app does is done with the package's functions, so it can also be done (and reproduced) from R.
